audit_items.proof_trace: The `createSupabaseAdminClient()` service-role client (full RLS bypass) is called inside `forceLogoutAll` (`system.service.ts:10`) which is exposed as `GET /api/admin/force-logout-all` with zero role/admin authorization — the middleware only verifies that any OAuth session cookie is present, not that the caller is an administrator. Any authenticated Discord user can trigger mass forced-logout of all checked-in users during JST 22:50–23:50. A second violation exists in `completeRegistration` (`actions.ts:208`): the admin client reads `temp_registrations` by caller-supplied `qr_token` without verifying the token was issued for the requesting user, allowing any authenticated user to claim any unexpired QR registration token and link an arbitrary physical card to their account.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Step 1: Attacker logs in with any valid Discord account (no special role needed). Step 2: During JST 22:50–23:50, attacker sends `GET /api/admin/force-logout-all` with their session cookie; the endpoint invokes `forceLogoutAll()` with admin client privileges, bulk-inserting 'out' records for every currently active user and corrupting all in-progress attendance sessions. Separately, an attacker who physically observes or photographs a kiosk QR code calls `completeRegistration` with that token to register the associated physical card to their own account, enabling impersonation at the kiosk.
